body.message:
Hello, I need you to please provide fresh and clean bed sheets and pillowcases, as my children have allergies and since yesterday they have developed itching all over their bodies.

The bedding currently provided does not appear to be clean, which is very concerning because of my children’s allergies. Also, the apartment is very stuffy and has poor ventilation.

Please change all the bed sheets and pillowcases and provide clean, freshly washed bedding. I would also appreciate it if you could improve the ventilation in the apartment as soon as possible.

Thank you for your cooperation.
